title: Cross-Server Arena button lockout, and one event switched off
summary: One limited-time activity entry (id 2080001) is disabled. The rest of the change is to client screens: the Cross-Server Arena challenge list now locks its buttons until the newest opponent list has arrived, and an opponent's displayed power is read from a different source.
highlights: Limited-time activity entry 2080001 is turned off; its label resolves only to the generic string More, so the exact event it gates cannot be named from the data.
Cross-Server Arena: the challenge, detail and refresh buttons stay greyed out until the latest opponent list comes back, so a stale opponent can no longer be entered.
Cross-Server Arena: an opponent's displayed power now comes from their base info rather than their ranking record.
